auditor_value: v = √(a₁a₂) t, proved from t = √(2d/a₂) − √(2d/a₁) and v = √(2d a₁) − √(2d a₂)

findings.note: Step 1 established t_B = √(2d/a₂), so the first term here must be √(2d/a₂), not √(4d/a₂); the distance under the root has been doubled. The printed middle expression equals neither the line above it nor the right-hand side, which is the correct simplification only of √(2d/a₂) − √(2d/a₁). A student copying this line carries a wrong time difference into the final ratio.

notes: Steps 1, 3 and 4 and the final result are correct; only the middle term of step 2 is false.
